label: NIS2 Directive cybersecurity risk-management and reporting

controls.title: Governance
controls.summary: Management bodies approve the risk-management measures, oversee them and take training.

controls.title: Cybersecurity risk-management measures
controls.summary: Appropriate and proportionate technical, operational and organisational measures (Article 21).

controls.title: Risk analysis and information system security policies
controls.summary: Policies for analysing risk and securing network and information systems.

controls.title: Incident handling
controls.summary: Prevent, detect, analyse, contain and respond to incidents, and recover from them.

controls.title: Business continuity and crisis management
controls.summary: Backup management, disaster recovery and crisis management.

controls.title: Supply chain security
controls.summary: Security of relationships with direct suppliers and service providers.

controls.title: Secure acquisition, development and maintenance
controls.summary: Security in buying, building and maintaining systems, including vulnerability handling and disclosure.

controls.title: Effectiveness assessment
controls.summary: Policies and procedures to assess whether the risk-management measures work.

controls.title: Cyber hygiene and training
controls.summary: Basic cyber hygiene practices and cybersecurity training.

controls.title: Cryptography and encryption
controls.summary: Policies and procedures on the use of cryptography and, where appropriate, encryption.

controls.title: Human resources security, access control and asset management
controls.summary: Personnel security, access control policies and asset management.

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication and secured communications
controls.summary: Multi-factor or continuous authentication, secured voice, video and text communications and secured emergency communications.

controls.title: Reporting obligations
controls.summary: Notify the CSIRT or competent authority of significant incidents (Article 23).

controls.title: Early warning
controls.summary: Within 24 hours of becoming aware of a significant incident.

controls.title: Incident notification
controls.summary: Within 72 hours of becoming aware, with an initial assessment.

controls.title: Final report
controls.summary: No later than one month after the incident notification.
